needed.why: Push aico/task-* branches, open and merge pull requests, read commit statuses.
Import issues as tasks and keep their labels and state in step.
Show which account the token acts as.

warnings: This token can only read the repository, so AICO cannot open or merge pull requests.
Checks are unreadable with this token (it needs Repository: read), so pull requests will show no checks. Gitea Actions report as commit statuses.
Branch protection unreadable (the token cannot read branch settings): AICO cannot see which reviews and checks main requires.
Gitea has milestones, not iterations or story points: milestones stand in for sprints and an "sp:5" label carries an estimate.

mergeBlockers: The branch has conflicts with the base branch.

protection.unreadable: the token cannot read branch settings
